_what_this_is: What a person approved, in the fields only a person can fill. The issuer re-derives every identity beside it and refuses on any disagreement, so this document cannot introduce a binding nobody checks.

reviewed_baseline._the_issuer_rederives_these: every identity here is re-derived live at issuance and a disagreement is a refusal. They are recorded so a reader can see WHAT was reviewed, not so anything trusts the copy.

covers: ONE Phase-C2 behavioural selection campaign: the five frozen Top-5 C candidates and incumbent B, materialized along deterministic digest-gated fixed paths as the reviewed execution path requires, six screening probes, exactly one mechanical screening advancement, six confirmation probes, the frozen screening and confirmation batteries, the frozen seeds, the frozen scoring contract, bootstrap seed 834816710, and the frozen Phase-C GO / NO_GO / INCONCLUSIVE decision rule. Same-campaign continuation only, under preregistered R1-R10.
_any_terminal_result_ends_the_campaign: a complete GO, NO_GO or INCONCLUSIVE is a valid terminal result and ends this campaign. None of them is a reason to start another attempt.
explicitly_not_authorized: any re-ranking of the frozen Top-5
any tie-break rung beyond the frozen rule

approved_money._is_a_campaign_ceiling: the $33.2099 is CUMULATIVE across every run attempt and provider resource of campaign c2-behavioural-12probe-v1. It is not a fresh allocation for each replacement resource.
approved_money._basis: the reviewed proposal basis at a quoted L40S securePrice of $1.09/h. Issuance re-quotes the live securePrice and derives the authorization terms mechanically from it.

live_rate_issuance_rule: derive the authorization terms mechanically from that live rate
bind rate_usd_per_hour, hard_runtime_minutes, gpu_hard_usd, disk_hard_usd and all_in_hard_usd distinctly
retain the reviewed scientific runtime and work scope
do not shorten the scientific experiment merely because the provider price increased
do not extend runtime or work because the provider price decreased
if the live quote materially changes the dollar authorization from the reviewed basis, STOP and return to the maintainer before creating the provider resource
a provider-returned rate above the authorized rate must refuse and tear down under the existing fail-closed contract
_one_use_is_per_chain: this grant authorizes ONE launch chain. A replacement resource inside the same campaign is a new run attempt with a fresh chain, permitted under R1-R10 and bounded by the SAME cumulative campaign ceiling above — not by a new allocation.

autonomous_engineering_repair.permitted: inside this scientific scope and the same cumulative campaign ceiling, ordinary engineering failures are handled autonomously: preserve evidence, confirm teardown and non-billing, diagnose, minimal repair, focused regression, fresh run identity and chain where required, continue. No approval is needed after each ordinary failure.
stop_and_return_if: continuing would require increasing the $33.2099 campaign ceiling
continuing would change the scientific protocol, arms, seeds, batteries, scoring or decision rule
continuing would change the approved provider or rate boundary
billing or resource ownership is uncertain
a scientific identity mismatch would be treated as an engineering retry
a complete valid verdict already exists

on_identity_mismatch: an arm whose rebuilt digest does not match the frozen record is a SCIENTIFIC FINDING and a stop condition, not a retryable engineering failure. The path is deterministic and would diverge identically on a retry. Preserve, tear down, and return it to review unchanged.
execution_chain: final live quote and all pre-provider gates
_ordering_is_binding: the binding-sensitive steps may not be skipped or reordered. The bundle must carry the authorization, so the authorization must exist first; and the lineage check permits exactly one tracked path to differ between the authorized base and the session commit, so the readiness record and the authorization are separate commits.
